answer: Make each identity earn its keep with an unpredictable per-epoch puzzle seeded by the previous payout hash, so answers cannot be precomputed before the dawn of the epoch opens. Spam farms drown in umber monotony, thousands of near-identical texts, while genuine thought reads like nectar to the graders. Because the seed only appears at epoch open and expires fast, a thousand clones cost a thousand fresh efforts, never just one.
